Launch planner and implementer AI CLIs side-by-side in tmux.

Usage: tandem [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  add-agent     add an agent to the running session (opened by the add-agent key)
  tab           switch agent tab in the focused column
  focus         focus a column or the status window
  close-agent   close the focused agent
  restart       restart an exited agent
  refresh       redraw tab titles
  reflow        re-stack columns for the terminal size
  reset-layout  reset pane sizes to the defaults
  quit          detach or quit
  help          show the key help
  first-run     open help once on first attach
  status        run the status window
  whats-new     show what changed in the last update
  update        update tandem and the workspace; agents keep running (F10 menu)
  click         dispatch a status-bar or pane-menu click action
  click-tab     open the agent menu for a clicked column title
  quota-feed    Claude Code statusline hook: record quota, then run your own statusline
  quota-line    print the quota line shown under the window
  save-exit     save the session state and end the session
  discard-exit  end the session and delete the saved state
  reload        restart tandem's own windows on the installed code
  placeholder   empty-column placeholder
  sidebar       run the agent sidebar
  show          show an agent in the main window
  select        select an agent or toggle it in the grid
  grid-scroll   scroll the multi-agent grid
  gridbar       run the grid overflow scrollbar
  equalize      equalize pane split or reset border to default
  reset-ui      reset UI layout, sizes, grid and sidebar to defaults
  snapshot      output workspace snapshot in JSON format
  answer-query  answer an agent coordination query
  list-ips      list host network IPs and active workspaces

Options:
      --resume   resume the saved session without asking
      --fresh    start blank with new conversations, without asking (the saved session is replaced)
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version
